heading: 50/50 Raffle — In Person Only
intro: We'll have a 50/50 raffle with tickets available for purchase in person only, by cash or credit card, at these NEOChosen events:

events.announcement: Friday, November 13: VIP Donor/Sponsor Dinner at Windows on the River, Cleveland.
Friday, November 13: An Evening with Cast Members from The Chosen at Lakewood Civic Auditorium.
Saturday, November 14: The Piano Guys concert at Akron Civic Theatre.
Saturday, November 14: Fairlawn Meet & Greet at St. Hilary Church.

closing: The raffle ends at the conclusion of the St. Hilary meet-and-greet on Saturday, November 14.
sunday: There will be no raffle at Sunday's November 15 event at Mayfield United Methodist Church.
